problem: Security finding 1 (medium, Gate 3): a crafted scene can hang rendering. sanitizeStyleRanges (~L473) accepts an unbounded number of ranges, and normalizeStyleRanges (~L107) checks every range against every boundary segment (quadratic); getStyledLines re-normalises on every canvas redraw (renderElement.ts ~L713) and SVG export (staticSvgScene.ts ~L823). Fix: cap the range count in sanitizeStyleRanges (export a MAX_STYLE_RANGES constant, e.g. 1000, and drop ranges beyond it after sorting); rewrite normalizeStyleRanges as one sort plus a single linear pass (boundary sweep), same output contract (sorted, non-overlapping, clamped, empty/style-less dropped, equal-style neighbours merged); in getStyledLines use the stored ranges as already normalised (clamp only), never re-normalise at draw time. Security finding 2 (low): color and highlight only need to be non-empty strings and reach SVG fill attributes. Fix: in sanitizeStyleRanges accept a colour only if it is a valid CSS colour (use the same validity check the codebase already uses for colours, e.g. isColorValid / tinycolor from @excalidraw/common if exported; otherwise a strict #hex / rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/named-colour regex that rejects url( and any parenthesised function other than rgb/rgba/hsl/hsla) and its length is at most 64 characters; drop the invalid property, and drop the range if it has neither. Keep every existing export and signature.

FR-24 defect (Gate 3): undo does not reverse a range colour applied while editing. Failing test packages/excalidraw/tests/textStyleRanges.test.tsx > 'undo restores the previous ranges and redo re-applies them': after picking red on range [12,19) in the editor, exiting the editor and pressing undo, the red range is still on the element (expected false, received true), even with the text committed to history beforehand. Suspected cause: shiftRangesTo calls mutateElement with informMutation: false, so styleRanges changes made while the editor is open never reach the store/history, and the editor's exit commit then folds them into a state history already treats as the baseline. Fix so that range changes made while editing are recorded by the store like the text change itself (the editor's onChange / exit commit must carry the element's current styleRanges, and no styleRanges write may bypass the store's change detection). Do not change the textarea behaviour or the range-shifting rules.

FR-24 defect (Gate 3): undo does not reverse a range colour applied while editing. Failing test packages/excalidraw/tests/textStyleRanges.test.tsx > 'undo restores the previous ranges and redo re-applies them' (red range still present after undo). The range-pick branch (applyRangeStylePick, ~L202) returns the new element with captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.IMMEDIATELY while a text element is being edited; check that this capture actually records a history entry for styleRanges while appState.editingTextElement is set (the store/history may skip or overwrite the element being edited, and the editor's later commit can replace it). Make a range pick one undoable history entry: undo restores the previous styleRanges, redo re-applies them, and the editor's later commit must not erase that entry. Element-level colour behaviour must not change.
